headline: Two-tile stubs: runs shorter than the minimum are dropped.
purpose: A village of two-tile path stubs. A compass run shorter than two tiles is dropped, so this is the degenerate case where the local list is nearly empty while the character stands on a road.

expected.note: The only local run from the spawn should be about one tile; the market has to come from the distant list.

notes: Distance from the spawn to the market is about nine tiles, past the compass radius, so the two systems do not compete here.
Score: reaches the market without shuffling inside the stub, and the route does not revisit the same stub cell twice.
